execution_classes.replay_safe: May rerun only when the operation is intrinsically safe and returns the same logical result.
execution_classes.state_reconcilable: After interruption, observe the requested postcondition and complete only when it is proven; do not blindly repeat.
execution_classes.externally_idempotent: Reserved for a Core integration whose external API accepts the same Canvas idempotency key and contractually deduplicates it.
execution_classes.non_repeatable: Never retry after execution may have begun; recover as unknown_outcome unless an authoritative postcondition can prove the result.

commands.postcondition: Return the exact bounded message without hardware, filesystem, network, or external side effects.

commands.parameter_contract: planned: target renderer session and known-good revision
commands.postcondition: The target renderer reports ready on the requested known-good revision.

commands.parameter_contract: planned: Core-issued media session and approved candidate IDs, never arbitrary credentials
commands.postcondition: A correlated Edge player event reports playing for the requested media session.
The correlated Edge player reports paused or an already-terminal session.
The correlated Edge player reports stopped/ended and audio focus is restored.

commands.parameter_contract: planned: bounded duration and non-sensitive label
commands.postcondition: A bounded identification overlay is shown; repeating it causes no persistent mutation.

commands.parameter_contract: planned: empty parameters plus explicit Core authorization/preconditions
commands.postcondition: A new boot identity/uptime may reconcile success; an ambiguous crash remains unknown_outcome.

commands.parameter_contract: planned: empty parameters plus explicit Core authorization/preconditions
commands.postcondition: Power-off cannot be safely auto-retried after the execution boundary.
